latest_commit.subject: field run 2 concluded: 43/50 in 37.4 h, zero reboots, battery exhaustion
latest_commit.body:
fw 0.1.161 + ULP dev.0.24, audit OFF. Started 07-31 22:27:14 UTC, died
08-02 11:48:26 UTC. Safe posture: BP parked at 11:48:18 and disabled at
11:48:26, clean final sync, no early-warning burst, ZERO reboots across
37.4 h (48 h board uptime).

Endurance result worth recording: 37.4 h audit-OFF vs run 011's 36.0 h
audit-ON — turning the deque audit off bought only ~1.4 h, so the audit
was NOT the dominant drain and the 44h10m reference is not explained by
audit state alone (that run used a 109-min cadence with 22 samples, far
less pump duty; sample rate here 1.15/h vs run 011's 1.14/h).

Timing: mostly 0-2 s deltas with two bounded +14/+15 s excursions that
both self-corrected. Faults: 7 BP stall + 3 BP start-FAIL, all in one
31-minute window on 08-01 and all bp_state_word=1 (BP_RUNNING
inter-edge watchdog), plus 2 isolated AC stalls; nothing in the final
20 hours.

The INCOMPLETE report was generated through the HUBR-324 manual
open-tail override (43 sample rows, dual-signed) — first real use of
that path on a dead, never-revived session.

reset_session deliberately NOT queued: the board is dead and a queued
reset would consume the resume on revival (#65).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
